channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strike damages hospital in southern Lebanon
item.description: An Israeli attack near Jabal Amel Hospital in Tyre has destroyed wards and medical equipment.

item.title: Iran warns Israeli attacks in Lebanon and Gaza threaten US ceasefire talks
item.description: Iranian officials demand 'ceasefire on all fronts' as Israel deepens Lebanon invasion and threatens to bomb Beirut.

item.title: Lebanon says Hezbollah agrees reciprocal halt to attacks on Israel
item.description: Israel's PM Netanyahu warns that strikes on Beirut will go ahead if Hezbollah does not abide by the US proposal.

item.title: Bowen: Trump needs this war to end but Iran is not backing down
item.description: Under pressure from the polls and Gulf allies, the White House is pushing for a deal but Iran wants concessions, writes BBC's international editor.

item.title: Trump seeking edits to US-Iran deal, US media report
item.description: The requested changes are related to the Strait of Hormuz and the removal of highly enriched uranium, according to US media.

item.title: Iran attacks damage 20 US military sites since start of war, satellite images show
item.description: Analysts told BBC Verify that Tehran's strikes were more extensive than publicly acknowledged.
